candidates.title: Will Holger Rune win at least 1.5 more games than Zizou Bergs?

candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Holger Rune vs Zizou Bergs professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm 1/16 Finals.
